headline: Brady Tkachuk returns to Ottawa for first time since trade
take:
ESPN reports that Brady Tkachuk is back in Ottawa for the first time since he asked for and received a trade from the Senators. He now plays for FLA.

His start in Florida is strong, and the underlying numbers back it up. Tkachuk has 6 goals and 10 points in 9 games so far this season. His own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his shots) are 4.65, so he is scoring about 1.35 above that, a small sample but not a wild overperformance. At five on five, FLA has 60.69 percent of the expected goals when he is on the ice, and the team's share runs 7.11 points better with him than without him. That points to real two-way impact, not just finishing luck.

For FLA, the picture is solid: a 5-2-2 record and 53.5 percent of expected goals overall. OTT sits 6-3-0 but at 50.6 percent, with a 49 percent five-on-five share, so their record looks a bit kinder than their play.
